# Printnode: Automated printing of PDF Tickets

# PrintNode Integration - Automatic Printing for Your Orders

We've integrated PrintNode to make printing your order tickets effortless and reliable.

## What PrintNode does

PrintNode automatically sends your PDF tickets (created in PDF Designer) directly to your printers—no manual downloading or printing needed. When an order comes in, the right ticket prints on the right printer, instantly.

## Key features

- **Free for Pixfizz customers** - No additional cost to use this service
- **Easy setup** - Create your PrintNode account through OrderHub, then install the PrintNode software on one computer at each location
- **Multiple printers** - Connect as many printers as you need at each location and assign different ticket types to different printers (Film tickets to the Film Zebra printer, Order Tickets to the front counter, labels to your label printer, etc.)
- **Monitored and reliable** - We keep track of your print queue and monitor which computers and printers are connected, so you'll know if something goes offline

## Getting started

Simply set up your PrintNode account through OrderHub, install the software on your location's computer, connect your printers, and you're ready to start automatic printing.
